# MyProspects

> MyProspects is a Local Sphere product for website visitor identity, intent intelligence, and audience activation.

## Public pages

- [Website Visitor Identification & Intent Data | MyProspects](https://www.myprospects.com/): Identify website visitors, enrich prospect profiles, prioritize intent, and activate audiences with MyProspects for sales, marketing, recruitment, and nonprofits.
- [Person-Level Identity and Intent Platform — MyProspects](https://www.myprospects.com/product): Turn anonymous visitor signals into named profiles, intent scores, activation audiences, and measurable buyer journeys with MyProspects.
- [Transparent Identity Resolution Pricing — MyProspects](https://www.myprospects.com/pricing): Compare MyProspects plans by Monthly Unique Resolved Visitors: 1,000 for $499, 5,000 for $1,999, or 10,000 for $2,499 per month. Contact us for Enterprise pricing.
